mentions.name: Fridge Camera
mentions.description: A fridge camera that keeps track of what is inside the refrigerator, aimed at helping the owner use fresh vegetables before they spoil. It is a physical device built because no good existing solutions are available.
mentions.problem: No good fridge camera solutions exist, and fresh vegetables get forgotten and dumped, creating a sense of food waste.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a fridge camera; no good solutions exist and I need it to avoid that feeling that I get when I dump my large bag of fresh vegetables.
